simple.summary: אׇחֳרֵין (ʼochŏrêyn) means last First listed occurrence: Dan 4 5.

definitions.full: H318. ochoreyn אחרין Dan 4:5 Kt, דָּנִיֵּאל מַי קֳדָ עַל אחרין וְעַד ; very dubious (see Commentaries); usually and unto the last (= at last ) came in, etc.; but word in this sense unknown: Qr אָחֳרָן ; read perhaps (Bev) אָחֳרָן וְעֹד (or ? Kt אַחֲרִין ; compare) and yet another came in before me.
